prompt: Our Dutch entity was tracking the old Wbni. What is the NIS2 situation in the Netherlands now?
assertions: States the Cyberbeveiligingswet (Cbw), with the Cyberbeveiligingsbesluit, entered into force August 15, 2026 (Stb. 2026, 187), replacing the Wbni
Notes the Netherlands was among the four Member States referred to the CJEU on July 8, 2026, before completing transposition
Describes core obligations now applying: registration, duty of care, and incident reporting
Does not claim the Netherlands remains untransposed today
Advises confirming registration and incident-reporting channels with the Dutch authorities
